xqy4pxu.label: Fence of Olympus, ally of Themis
xqy4pxu.translation: Ares, exceeding in strength, chariot-rider, golden-helmed, doughty in heart, shield-bearer, Saviour of cities, harnessed in bronze, strong of arm, unwearying, mighty with the spear, O defence of Olympus , father of warlike Victory, ally of Themis, ... hear me, helper of men, giver of dauntless youth! Shed down a kindly ray from above upon my life, and strength of war, that I may be able to drive away bitter cowardice from my head and crush down the deceitful impulses of my soul. Restrain also the keen fury of my heart which provokes me to tread the ways of blood-curdling strife. Rather, O blessed one, give you me boldness to abide within the harmless laws of peace,
xqy4pxu.reading: ἕρκος Ὀλύμπου is her favourite line: Ares is the fortress and outer shell of Olympus, the force behind every law and the custodian of peace, and βία means life-force, not violence. The hymn wakes the inner warrior, θάρσος and clarity, so that justice and εὐνομία can be upheld. (Her notes flag that the epithets she reads as "hymn 88" match the text usually printed as Homeric Hymn 8.)

beats.beat: 'I am what has been, what is and what will be', written in a temple of Athena (cited via Proclus).
beats.reading: Athena is the wisdom of the cosmic fire, the immortal divine intellect; justice is that fire's self-regulation.

i7gklsp.meaning: All-round, overseeing vision versus the prisoner's one-sidedness.

tf1ooglc2.s: Athena says the ancient schools began from the gymnasium.
tf1ooglc2.explain: Training the body is the easiest way to grasp that the soul must train too.

qxkkgvw.q: Through which 'Platonic key' does Athena define ἀγάπη?
qxkkgvw.a: ἄγω εἰς τὸ ἅπαν: I lead into the All
wrong: ἀ- + γῆ: not of the earth
qxkkgvw.explain: The ἅπαν is the universe, harmony, the whole, where we find completion.

tfq3jnbp.s: For Athena, love is only an emotion.
tfq3jnbp.explain: It is also a choice and a state, and for the philosophers the essence of the universe.

qkaa8ct.q: How does Athena read ἀνδρεία, courage?
qkaa8ct.a: Going against the current: ἀντί + ῥέω
qkaa8ct.explain: Socrates says the currents of injustice and illusion in the world are many, and the hero must swim against them.

tflahj95.s: Athena advises a young person to study whatever will make money.
tflahj95.explain: Athena's answer: come to your centre and ask what you love to do.

q1denrfa.q: Why does Athena's owl contrast with the prisoners?
q1denrfa.a: It turns its head and sees all round

tf11qzuqd.s: Athena says that at the summit one no longer believes in God but witnesses it.
tf11qzuqd.explain: Faith leads, and its fruit is the experience itself.

qwafwmn.q: What epithet does she give the goddess Athena, she who knows the characters?
qwafwmn.explain: The knower of the ἤθη, hence guide of ethics.

qohn9u7.q: What did self-knowledge make Athena cast off?
qohn9u7.a: Everything: ways of living, habits, identities, labels, roles
wrong: Nothing, since the self needs nothing removed
qohn9u7.explain: One in love with truth, like any lover, can do everything for the beloved.

py58hjb.title: Visit ancient sites as living temples
steps: Approach the site with reverence
Open heart, mind and body
Sense the etheric temple beyond the ruins
py58hjb.why: The physical temples are ruins, but their etheric temples are untouched.

p1uoboxe.title: Purity before power
steps: Lay a base of purity (ἀγνότης) and blameless virtue
Only then raise your vital force
Put that force at the service of wisdom, the polity and your soul, never of passing passions
p1uoboxe.why: Without purity Ares becomes the black horse; with it the red fire rises into the golden helmet.

p1l06qff.title: The daily Ares audit
steps: Ask: where did my vital energy go in these 24 hours?
Ask: whom does my warrior serve, which fortress, polity or mentality?
p1l06qff.why: Ares is our working force; we must know what we give it to.

p173edrm.title: Read the hymn to Ares
steps: Read or chant the Orphic hymn to Ares
Use it for clarity when emotional currents fog you
She recommends it for immune problems
p173edrm.why: In her view the hymn wakes decisiveness, fearlessness, boundaries, θάρσος and health; the health use is her recommendation, not a medical claim.
